pages.title: From Hand to Hand
pages.text: Seasonal decorations commemorate a consensual exchange without recreating anyone's gift.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: During New Year, the sender uses /jem holiday gift <player> for a whole held stack; recipient accepts the shown UUID. Unaccepted gifts can be canceled. Escrow survives the holiday window. Do not share passwords or gift yourself.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Gifts use durable escrow and recipient consent; cancel/accept cannot duplicate the stack, and calendar end does not erase pending delivery.
